row_granularity: one claim block, with claimant subrows and a claim total
notes: Page 1 contains a Commercial Package Summary. Claim blocks begin on page 2 and continue on subsequent pages, grouped under a repeating Term header. Each claim block contains Claim number, Line of business, Loss date, Loss description, Status, Close date, claimant subrows, Outstanding loss reserve, Incurred loss, and Claim total. A policy-period aggregate appears as Term total at the end of the term. The policy number and report header repeat on each page.
